input: Sign up for a beginner's glassblowing workshop nearby

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the user's location determines which studios and workshops are actually 'nearby' and searchable.
The user may have a specific window of availability, which narrows which workshop dates are viable.
Beginner glassblowing workshops vary widely in price; a budget ceiling filters out unaffordable options.
Whether this is just for the user or for a group (e.g., friends, a partner, a gift) changes how many spots to book and what type of session to seek.
Some workshops focus on specific techniques or produce a specific object (e.g., ornament, vase, paperweight); knowing a preference narrows the search meaningfully.
Understanding what the user most values — hands-on time, a take-home piece, a certified instructor, small class size — helps prioritise between comparable options.
Knowing how far the user is willing to travel defines the practical search radius and transport considerations.

gold.taskTitle: Sign up for a local beginner glassblowing workshop
gold.taskDescription: Find and register for a beginner-level glassblowing workshop at a nearby studio or venue.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood are you based in?
questions.description: The user's location is needed to search for workshops that are actually nearby.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the studio?
questions.description: Defines the practical search radius — e.g., within 5 miles, 15 miles, or happy to drive 30+ minutes.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or timeframe in mind?
questions.description: Identifies whether the user needs a session in the next week, a specific weekend, or is flexible.

questions.title: What is your budget for the workshop fee?
questions.description: Beginner sessions typically range from $50 to $200+; a ceiling helps filter options quickly.

questions.title: Is this just for you, or are you booking for others too?
questions.description: Determines whether to look for individual spots or a group/private session booking.

questions.title: Is there a specific item you want to make, like an ornament or vase?
questions.description: Many studios offer theme-specific sessions; a preference narrows the search to the right workshop type.

questions.title: What matters most to you in choosing a workshop?
questions.description: Helps prioritise between options — e.g., maximum hands-on time, a take-home piece, small class size, or a highly rated instructor.
